title: silent running clock
text: silent running clock. Purchased this clock to replace a SUPER noisy one in the kitchen.  This one is plain... not fancy.. but it functions just as it should and it is SILENT.  Peace at last.  I like it.  Takes one AA battery that is NOT included.  As long as it is silent, it will have a home.  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Bernhard Products Silver Wall Clock 8" Silent Non-Ticking Quality Quartz Battery Operated Clock for Home Kitchen Bedroom Bathroom Classroom Nursery Room Easy to Read
features: 8 inch clock. Decorate and enhance your bedroom, classroom, kitchen, bathroom, school or office with this classic wall clock. Works with any decor!
Silent non-ticking mechanism with sweeping movement, allows you to rest in silence. Precise Quartz movements guarantee accurate time
Silver colored frame. Black numbers and hands against white background creates easy viewing from any angle. Red second hand provides extra clarity
Small size great for smaller spaces. Quality construction. Sturdy plastic frame and premium glass cover ensures protection from dust. Lightweight and easy to hang
Large nail slot offers easy no-fuss and fast installation. Uses 1 "AA" battery - not included (Note: Plus side of battery should be inserted first) 1-Year Manufacture Warranty
